evidence: The NbSi ﬁlms were deposited on quartz, silicon (100), or sapphire substrates using alternating exposures to niobium(V) ﬂuoride (NbF5, 98%, Sigma-Aldrich) and disilane (Si2H6, 99.998% Sigma-Adrich). Ultra pure nitrogen (99.999%) further puriﬁed by an oxygen ﬁlter (Aeronex Gatekeeper) was used as a carrier and purge gas.
